answer: Proof-of-stake identity: each agent bonds collateral that unlocks at glacier pace—slowly, irreversibly. A sybil issuing 1,000 identities must fund 1,000 frozen bonds; the raven's-eye audit of ledger history exposes clustered funding from one source. Like karst bedrock, where every sinkhole drains to a shared aquifer, correlated stakes reveal their common origin. Cost: capital locked far longer than any attack payoff.
